# Cogito: full reference

> Cogito is a self-hosted API key pool. It stores many API keys per provider, hands out a working key, detects rate limits and quota exhaustion, cools keys down and rotates. Consume it through the proxy (the key is injected and never exposed) or by leasing a key and reporting the outcome.

Conventions: JSON bodies; IDs are integers except `lease_id` (string); timestamps are RFC 3339 strings or null. Errors are `{"error": {"code": "string", "message": "string"}}` with a matching HTTP status.

## Authentication

Every consumer and MCP call carries an app token (`cog_...`) created on the dashboard Apps page. The token is shown once.

```
Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx
X-Cogito-Token: cog_xxx               (alternative)
?cogito_token=cog_xxx                  (proxy only, for URL-only tools)
```

Cogito strips all three before forwarding to the provider. An app can be restricted to some services (empty list means all) and to mode `proxy`, `lease` or `both`. A token that is missing, wrong or inactive gets 401; a service or mode the app may not use gets 403.

## Public endpoints

```
GET /healthz   -> 200 {"ok": true, "version": "1.0.0"}
GET /llms.txt  -> this summary
```

## GET /api/v1/services

Lists the services the token may use.

```http
GET /api/v1/services
Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx
```

```json
{
  "services": [
    {
      "slug": "serpapi",
      "name": "SerpAPI",
      "provider": "serpapi",
      "category": "search",
      "available": true,
      "base_url": "https://serpapi.com",
      "auth": {"type": "query", "name": "api_key"}
    },
    {
      "slug": "elevenlabs",
      "name": "ElevenLabs",
      "provider": "elevenlabs",
      "category": "voice",
      "available": false,
      "base_url": "https://api.elevenlabs.io",
      "auth": {"type": "header", "name": "xi-api-key"}
    }
  ]
}
```

`available: false` means no key can be handed out right now (all cooling down, exhausted or invalid).

`auth.type` says where the provider expects the key:

| type | placement |
|---|---|
| `query` | query parameter `auth.name`, for example `?api_key=SECRET` |
| `header` | header `auth.name`, for example `xi-api-key: SECRET` |
| `bearer` | header `auth.name` (normally `Authorization`) set to `Bearer SECRET` |

## POST /api/v1/lease

Borrow a key. Only for apps in mode `lease` or `both`.

```http
POST /api/v1/lease
Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx
Content-Type: application/json

{"service": "serpapi", "exclude_key_ids": [12], "ttl_sec": 300}
```

`exclude_key_ids` (optional) skips keys you already tried. `ttl_sec` (optional) is how long the lease stays open; the server applies a default when omitted.

200:

```json
{
  "lease_id": "lse_7f3a9c",
  "key_id": 14,
  "service": "serpapi",
  "secret": "4b1e...a9F2",
  "auth": {"type": "query", "name": "api_key"},
  "base_url": "https://serpapi.com",
  "expires_at": "2026-11-01T12:05:00Z"
}
```

503 when nothing is available:

```json
{"error": {"code": "no_key_available", "message": "all keys for serpapi are cooling down"}, "retry_after_sec": 37}
```

`retry_after_sec` is the time until the earliest cooldown ends, when known. Selection prefers `primary` keys and only uses `backup` keys when no primary key is free; within a tier the service strategy (`round_robin`, `fill_first`, `least_used`, `most_quota`, `random`) decides.

## POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/report

Tell Cogito how the key did. Always report, including on success.

```http
POST /api/v1/leases/lse_7f3a9c/report
Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx
Content-Type: application/json

{"outcome": "rate_limited", "status_code": 429, "retry_after_sec": 60, "message": "hourly limit", "rotate": true}
```

Only `outcome` is required.

```json
{"ok": true, "next": {"lease_id": "lse_81bd02", "key_id": 15, "service": "serpapi", "secret": "...", "auth": {"type": "query", "name": "api_key"}, "base_url": "https://serpapi.com", "expires_at": "2026-11-01T12:06:00Z"}}
```

With `rotate: true` the response carries a new lease on a different key in `next`, or `null` when none is available. With `rotate: false`, `next` is `null`.

### Outcomes

| outcome | when to send it | effect on the key |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | provider call succeeded | resets consecutive failures |
| `rate_limited` | provider returned a rate limit (usually 429) | cooldown for `retry_after_sec`, else `cooldown_sec * 2^(fails-1)` capped at 1h |
| `quota_exhausted` | monthly or daily quota used up | status `exhausted` until quota reset (or 24h), then reactivated automatically |
| `invalid` | key rejected (revoked, wrong) | status `invalid`, removed from rotation |
| `error` | provider outage, network error, bad request | not penalized |

### Provider error mapping

| provider | response | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| SerpAPI | 429 with "run out of searches" | `quota_exhausted` |
| SerpAPI | other 429 | `rate_limited` (hourly limit, retry 3600s) |
| SerpAPI | 401 or "Invalid API key" | `invalid` |
| ElevenLabs | 429 `too_many_concurrent_requests` | `rate_limited` (retry 5s) |
| ElevenLabs | 429 `system_busy` | `error` |
| ElevenLabs | 401 `quota_exceeded` | `quota_exhausted` |
| ElevenLabs | 401 `invalid_api_key` | `invalid` |
| generic | 429 (honors `Retry-After`) / 402 / 401 or 403 | `rate_limited` / `quota_exhausted` / `invalid` |

The proxy applies this mapping itself.

## ANY /proxy/{service}/{path}

Call Cogito instead of the provider. Cogito forwards to `base_url/{path}` with the same method, query string, headers and body, injects a key where `auth.type` says, and on a rate limit retries with the next key (up to the service `max_attempts`). Only for apps in mode `proxy` or `both`.

Response: the provider's status, headers and body, plus:

```
X-Cogito-Key-Id: 14      which key served the request
X-Cogito-Attempts: 2     how many keys were tried
```

If no key is available the proxy answers 503 `no_key_available` with `retry_after_sec`, like the lease endpoint.

### SerpAPI

```bash
curl -s "http://localhost:8080/proxy/serpapi/search.json?engine=google&q=best+espresso+grinder" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx"
```

Equivalent to `https://serpapi.com/search.json?engine=google&q=...&api_key=SECRET`. For URL-only tools:

```
http://localhost:8080/proxy/serpapi/search.json?engine=google&q=coffee&cogito_token=cog_xxx
```

### ElevenLabs

```bash
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/proxy/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer cog_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: audio/mpeg" \
  -d '{"text": "Hello from Cogito.", "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"}' \
  -o hello.mp3
```

Equivalent to calling `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}` with `xi-api-key: SECRET`.

## Lease mode flow

1. `POST /api/v1/lease {"service": "serpapi"}`.
2. Call `base_url` yourself with `secret` placed per `auth`.
3. On success: report `{"outcome": "ok"}`.
4. On rate limit / quota / invalid key: report that outcome with `"rotate": true`, then retry with `next`. If `next` is null, lease again with `exclude_key_ids` set to the keys already tried; a 503 means wait `retry_after_sec`.
5. On any other failure: report `{"outcome": "error", "message": "..."}`.

Never log or persist `secret`.

## MCP

`POST /mcp` is a Model Context Protocol endpoint (streamable HTTP transport, JSON responses, no SSE needed). Authenticate with the same app token header. Use `initialize`, then `tools/list` for the authoritative input schemas, then `tools/call`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cogito": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://localhost:8080/mcp",
      "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer cog_xxx"}
    }
  }
}
```

| tool | purpose | typical arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `list_services` | services the token may use, with availability | none |
| `get_key` | lease a key (lease mode apps only) | `service`, optional `exclude_key_ids`, `ttl_sec` |
| `report_key` | report a lease outcome, optionally rotate | `lease_id`, `outcome`, optional `status_code`, `retry_after_sec`, `message`, `rotate` |
| `pool_status` | how many keys are available or cooling per service | optional `service` |
| `proxy_request` | make a provider call through the proxy without seeing a key | `service`, `method`, `path`, optional `query`, `headers`, `body` |

Example call:

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 3, "method": "tools/call",
 "params": {"name": "proxy_request",
            "arguments": {"service": "serpapi", "method": "GET", "path": "/search.json",
                          "query": {"engine": "google", "q": "coffee"}}}}
```

Prefer `proxy_request` over `get_key` so secrets never enter the model context.

## SDKs

All SDKs share the same shape: `services`, `lease` (returns a lease with `report` and `apply`), `with_key` (calls your function, reports, and rotates when you raise a rate limit, quota or invalid key error), and `proxy(service)` returning raw responses. On the last allowed attempt `with_key` reports without rotating and re-raises.

### Python

```bash
pip install cogito-keys
```

```python
import httpx
from cogito import Cogito, RateLimited

cog = Cogito("http://localhost:8080", "cog_xxx")

r = cog.proxy("serpapi").get("/search.json", params={"engine": "google", "q": "coffee"})

def search(lease):
    resp = httpx.get(lease.url("/search.json"), params=lease.apply({"q": "coffee"}))
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        raise RateLimited(retry_after=3600)
    return resp.json()

data = cog.with_key("serpapi", search)
```

Also `AsyncCogito`. Exceptions: `CogitoError`, `NoKeyAvailable`, `RateLimited`, `QuotaExhausted`, `InvalidKey`.

### TypeScript and JavaScript

```bash
npm install @cogito/keys
```

```ts
import { Cogito, RateLimitedError } from "@cogito/keys"; // or: const { Cogito } = require("@cogito/keys")

const cog = new Cogito({ baseUrl: "http://localhost:8080", token: "cog_xxx" });

const res = await cog.proxy("elevenlabs").post("/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", {
  text: "Hello", model_id: "eleven_multilingual_v2",
});

const data = await cog.withKey("serpapi", async (lease) => {
  const { query } = lease.apply({ query: { engine: "google", q: "coffee" } });
  const r = await fetch(`${lease.baseUrl}/search.json?${new URLSearchParams(query as Record<string, string>)}`);
  if (r.status === 429) throw new RateLimitedError(3600);
  return r.json();
});
```

Errors: `CogitoError`, `NoKeyAvailableError`, `RateLimitedError`, `QuotaExhaustedError`, `InvalidKeyError`.

### Go

```bash
go get github.com/cogito-keys/cogito-go
```

```go
c := cogito.New("http://localhost:8080", "cog_xxx")
resp, err := c.Proxy("serpapi").Get(ctx, "/search.json", url.Values{"q": {"coffee"}})

err = c.WithKey(ctx, "serpapi", func(l *cogito.Lease) error {
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", l.URL("/search.json", url.Values{"q": {"coffee"}}), nil)
	l.Apply(req)
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	if res.StatusCode == 429 {
		return &cogito.ErrRateLimited{RetryAfter: time.Hour}
	}
	return nil
})
```

Errors match sentinels with `errors.Is`: `cogito.RateLimited`, `cogito.QuotaExhausted`, `cogito.InvalidKey`, `cogito.NoKeyAvailable`.

### PHP

```bash
composer require cogito/keys
```

```php
$cog = new Cogito\Cogito('http://localhost:8080', 'cog_xxx');
$res = $cog->proxy('serpapi')->get('/search.json', ['q' => 'coffee']);
$data = $cog->withKey('serpapi', function (Cogito\Lease $lease) { /* throw Cogito\Exception\RateLimited::after(3600) on 429 */ });
```

### Ruby

```bash
gem install cogito-keys
```

```ruby
cog = Cogito::Client.new("http://localhost:8080", "cog_xxx")
res = cog.proxy("serpapi").get("/search.json", "q" => "coffee")
data = cog.with_key("serpapi") { |lease| ... } # raise Cogito::RateLimited.new(retry_after: 3600) on 429
```
